characterization: Every dish this household has actually finished asks them to press something flat against a hot pan. They browse widely — three or four recipes a sitting, twice a week — and almost all of that browsing is reconnaissance that ends in a skip; roughly every two weeks one recipe survives the session and gets cooked, always after they open the explanatory note first. The one abandonment happened at step three, in the middle of the sear itself, and they came back weeks later and finished that same recipe twice. Cacio e pepe is the dish they open most and have never once started, despite it having the fewest ingredients on the site.
salientInference: Across ninety days, everything you finished asked you to press something flat in a pan; what you only reread asks for timing.

signals.rhythm: Twice-weekly reconnaissance, one commitment every fortnight — and the cook is always the last recipe opened that day
